name: Katekyo's first date
source:
For 25-year-old Katekyo Namida, today is an important day, as it is his first date ever. But don't think this date is the result of hazardous cirmcustances or even fate: Katekyo never experienced any form of sexual attraction in his life, and, finally taking the bull by the horns, met Lara, a lovely woman, on a dating app. But the date might confront him to the truth he's been avoiding...

[from [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/katekyos-first-date]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对25岁的Katekyo Namida而言，今天是个重要日子：他将迎来人生第一次约会。但别以为这次约会源于偶然，或是命运的安排。Katekyo从未对任何人产生过性吸引，如今终于决定迎难而上，通过约会应用结识了可爱的Lara。然而，这场约会或许会迫使他面对一直逃避的真相……

[摘自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/katekyos-first-date]itch.io[/url]]
